Mairana

Overview

Mairana is an Ingos archer who offers Zak protection outside the city walls. She seeks the experience needed to enter the Mercenaries’ Guild rather than immediate pay. Ingos remains her home, and she declines to leave it when Zak’s search moves on. [1, 2, 3]

Recruitment and farewell

Mairana introduces herself as an archer useful outside the city walls, where the population is hostile to strangers. She cannot yet demand a mercenary’s fee because she has not joined the Guild: experience is her immediate reward. A required permit can delay her departure from the city. While waiting, she avoids provoking Tilvar’s suspicions and credits Zak with improving the guards’ attitude towards her. At the end of their association, she explicitly chooses to remain on Ingos, which she considers her home. [1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 3, 7]
